name: Decile
description: Decile is an ecommerce customer intelligence platform. This connector lets you explore your store's performance and customers in plain language, putting analyst-level insights and recommendations in the hands of your team. Ask about revenue, orders, units, AOV, and profit; product and category performance; customer acquisition, retention, cohorts, and subscriptions. Deep dive into market basket analysis, sequential purchase flows, or compare your customers against US-population benchmarks. Describe a group of customers and get a profile of how they differ from your overall base across behavior, demographics, product preferences, and more. Turn that description into a defined customer segment and save it to your Decile account for reuse and activation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Decile to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Decile to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.decile.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Decile MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decile provides these MCP tools: get_default_brand, list_brands, query_data, switch_brand, create_segment, and generate_segment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Decile?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Decile in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Decile requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Decile is developed by Decile. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
